difficulty.rationale_zh: Where 地點詢問搭配直接樓層地點回答。

audio_script.text_en: Where should we set up the projector for the client briefing?

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

evidence.quote_en: Where should we set up the projector for the client briefing?
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「Where should we set up the projector for the client briefing?」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。
對應後續關鍵語句「(A) In the third-floor boardroom.」，直接印證正解 (A)「In the third-floor boardroom.」。問句以 Where 詢問客戶簡報投影機的架設地點，選項 (A)「在三樓董事會議室」直接回答地點。

items.explanation_zh: 問題以 Where 詢問「我們應該在哪裡架設客戶簡報用的投影機？」，(A)「在三樓董事會議室」直接給出地點。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 回答時間（兩點半），與 Where 地點提問不符。
Wh- 問句不可用 Yes 開頭回答。

vocabulary.example_en: The project director held a fifteen-minute morning briefing to review the client deliverables.

difficulty.rationale_zh: When 時間問句搭配完成條件時間回應。

audio_script.text_en: When will the preliminary revenue forecast be distributed to the vice presidents?
(B) As soon as the European branch submits its figures.

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

choices.text_en: As soon as the European branch submits its figures.

evidence.quote_en: When will the preliminary revenue forecast be distributed to the vice presidents?
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「When will the preliminary revenue forecast be distributed to the vice presidents?」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。

evidence.quote_en: (B) As soon as the European branch submits its figures.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(B) As soon as the European branch submits its figures.」，直接印證正解 (B)「As soon as the European branch submits its figures.」。問句以 When 詢問初步營收預測何時分發給副總裁們，選項 (B)「一旦歐洲分部提交數據就立刻發送」明確回答時間條件。

items.explanation_zh: 提問詢問初步營收預測何時（When）會分發給副總裁們，(B)「一旦歐洲分公司提交數據就會發出」以條件時間精準回答。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 聯想 revenue / sales，但回答比較結果而非時間。
回答來源部門（From...），對應 Where/Who 而非 When。

vocabulary.example_en: Initial soil tests yielded encouraging preliminary results for the new warehouse foundation.

difficulty.rationale_zh: 否定疑問句／附加問句搭配間接語用回應（轉移責任／提出查證行動）。

audio_script.text_en: Haven't the replacement gaskets for the bottling machine arrived from Osaka yet?
(A) No, they're made of synthetic rubber.
(B) I'll check the receiving dock log right now.

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

choices.text_en: No, they're made of synthetic rubber.
I'll check the receiving dock log right now.

evidence.quote_en: Haven't the replacement gaskets for the bottling machine arrived from Osaka yet?
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「Haven't the replacement gaskets for the bottling machine arrived from Osaka yet?」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。

evidence.quote_en: (B) I'll check the receiving dock log right now.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(B) I'll check the receiving dock log right now.」，直接印證正解 (B)「I'll check the receiving dock log right now.」。問句詢問從大阪寄出的裝瓶機替換墊片是否尚未送達，選項 (B)「我現在馬上查一下收貨碼頭紀錄」為合理的職場回應。

items.explanation_zh: 提問詢問「從大阪寄來的裝瓶機替換墊片還沒到嗎？」，(B)「我現在馬上查一下收貨月台紀錄」為自然間接回應（尚不確定但立即查證）。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 雖有 No，但後半句說明材質為合成橡膠，與是否到貨無關。
回答用途或班別，未回應貨物是否抵達。

vocabulary.example_en: A worn rubber gasket caused a minor coolant leak inside the auxiliary water pump.
All incoming freight deliveries must be signed for at the north receiving dock.

difficulty.rationale_zh: 陳述句抱怨（印表機又卡紙了）搭配主動提供替代方案之語用回應。

audio_script.text_en: The high-speed copier in the marketing wing is jamming again.
(A) You can print your handouts on the machine near the reception desk.
(B) Yes, fifty copies bound in folders.

assets.source_note_zh: 由本機 macOS TTS (/usr/bin/say + afconvert AAC 22.05kHz) 實際合成之單一完整時間軸音檔；角色配音：spk1(Questioner (Male Officer), planned=us -> voice=Reed (英文（美國）)[en_US])；spk2(Responder (Female Assistant), planned=uk -> voice=Shelley (英文（英國）)[en_GB])。

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

choices.text_en: You can print your handouts on the machine near the reception desk.
Yes, fifty copies bound in folders.

evidence.quote_en: The high-speed copier in the marketing wing is jamming again.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「The high-speed copier in the marketing wing is jamming again.」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。

evidence.quote_en: (A) You can print your handouts on the machine near the reception desk.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(A) You can print your handouts on the machine near the reception desk.」，直接印證正解 (A)「You can print your handouts on the machine near the reception desk.」。陳述句指出行銷部門的高速影印機又卡紙了，選項 (A) 建議改用接待處附近的機器列印講義，提供具體替代方案。

items.explanation_zh: 說話者陳述「行銷部門那台高速影印機又卡紙了」，(A)「你可以用接待櫃台旁那台機器列印講義」針對問題主動提供立即可行的替代解決方案。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 對抱怨設備故障的陳述句回答 Yes 與份數，語用不連貫。
重複題幹中的 marketing 一詞，但談論行銷總監昨日歸來，與影印機故障無關。

vocabulary.example_en: Heavy cardstock frequently causes the second-floor office printer to jam during large print runs.
The trainer distributed a two-page summary handout at the start of the compliance seminar.
